values.text: We asked 4,000 people how they feel about brands that change their logo for one month and then go quiet. The answer was clear: people notice whether you keep it up the rest of the year.
What happens when you stop marketing on gut feel

A small snack company from the north knew exactly what they were making. Their email marketing? By their own admission, guesswork.

They switched to us and planned properly. A year later their open rates are up by a third, and text messages finally work for them.
